# Alwin Lim Zh Chen

> Personal site of Alwin Lim Zh Chen, Chief of DAPSY Bukit Bendera 2024–2026, Penang, Malaysia. RMIT Economics & Finance graduate, INTI MBA, property professional, a voice for Penang's small businesses and workers. Available in English (alwinlim.com/), Bahasa Melayu (alwinlim.com/ms/) and Chinese (alwinlim.com/zh/).

## Main pages

- [Alwin Lim Zh Chen · DAPSY Bukit Bendera, Penang](https://alwinlim.com/): Home — Budget 2027 stance, views, journey, property projects and latest news.
- [About](https://alwinlim.com/about): Background, education, career and political journey.
- [Gallery](https://alwinlim.com/gallery): DAPSY Bukit Bendera activities, community, festivals and AL Team Penang.
